art_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a game character sprite sheet for a cosy woodland apothecary. ONE character: {character}. Hand-painted storybook watercolour, textured warm muted pigments, fine brown outlines. Transparent background. Exactly 3 columns by 3 rows equally spaced sprite cells, 1536x1152 total, each 512x384 cell. Each cell repeats the exact same front-facing waist-up character, direct eye contact, head and torso fully inside the cell, hands below bottom edge. Fixed body, hair, clothing, pose and alignment across all nine cells. Change ONLY eyelids and mouth. Row 1 neutral mouth, row 2 gentle smile, row 3 concerned frown. Columns 1 open eyes, 2 half-closed eyes, 3 fully closed eyes. No text, no grid lines, no props crossing cell boundaries. Soft warm lighting. Detailed expressive adult face. Torso fills bottom of each cell, head near upper centre.
